issues.title: Missing Verifies clauses for Phase 1-21
issues.why: While the meta-files (00, 97, 98, 99) have detailed ACs with Verifies clauses, the actual technical phases (01-21) are listed as 'must remain valid' but lack specific GWT criteria for their technical requirements (e.g., PSR-4 logging, singleton constraints).
issues.fix: Add a 'Technical Requirements' section to 97-acceptance-criteria.md with GWT/Verifies for the core architectural patterns defined in Phases 01-06.

issues.title: Broken internal link to Phase 2 sub-files
issues.why: 00-overview.md references '02-enums-and-coding-style/' as a subfolder, but the file inventory and links in 00-quick-start.md and 02-overview.md use inconsistent relative paths that may fail depending on the working directory of the AI.
issues.fix: Standardize all internal links to use the full relative path from the module root (e.g., ./02-enums-and-coding-style/01-enum-architecture.md).

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions in FileLogger
issues.why: Phase 01 and 04 specify a FileLogger singleton but do not address file locking (flock) or concurrent write handling, which is critical in high-traffic WordPress environments.
issues.fix: Add a requirement in 04-logging-and-error-handling.md for exclusive file locking during write operations.
